en-US.name: Between Sessions
en-US.summary: A private companion for your recurring 1:1 sessions, built on your Bee data.
en-US.description: Between Sessions answers from your own AWS account: your prep brief, what has happened since your last session, when the next one is, your agenda and takeaways. A development-stage skill for the developer's own account; never submitted for certification.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask between sessions when my next session is
Alexa, ask between sessions to prep me

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Private development skill. Not for certification.
